name: Pretty Pretty Please I Don't Want to Be a Magical Girl
original_name: Pretty Pretty Please I Don't Want to Be a Magical Girl
overview:
Pretty Pretty Please I Don't Want to Be a Magical Girl (2025)

Aika's lost her love for being a magical girl but keeps fighting anyway. With help from sidekick Hoshi and friend Zira, she strives to find her spark again while facing villains Eclipse and Lady DeVoid.
